geometry_bands.source_anchor: lobbed cluster bomb whose fragments scatter on impact in a small radius, with a pierce component and internal trauma ('Cluster bomb: lobbed at target, fragments scatter on impact in small radius'; 'bigger pierce component and non transmutable internal trauma -- scatter/fragment damage on impact'). multi_projectile carries the cluster-fragment-scatter identity (phrase-book shotgun/volley/barrage -> multi_projectile). INTERNAL TRAUMA -> bleed (§A GD Internal-Trauma row = phys-DoT bleed): 'non transmutable internal trauma' is NAMED in fetched text on this skill, so bleed emits. Element fire (elem_raw / Demolitionist fire family).

thrown debuff/CC utility ('toss Flashbang'; 'Flashbang as debuff/CC'; 'Flashbang listed as Insane debuff'). ground_targeted_circle for the thrown-area debuff. NO ailment token: the fetched anchor names only 'debuff'/'Insane debuff' (shape-neutral); 'Flashbang' NAME does not attest blind, and 'stun' appears only in probe + claim-paraphrase, NOT in a fetched anchor -> both blind AND stun WITHHELD (§0.2 probe-illegal, §0.4 name-collision). See near-miss.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: multi_projectile for the cluster-fragment scatter. bleed EMITTED via the §A GD Internal-Trauma row (internal trauma = phys-DoT bleed) -- 'non transmutable internal trauma' is NAMED on Canister Bomb in fetched text. Element fire (elem_raw / Demolitionist family); the fetched core-skill language emphasizes pierce + internal-trauma (physical-substrate) so fire is the base-identity slot while bleed carries the phys ailment. Flashbang: STUN and BLIND both WITHHELD -- 'stun/daze' is present only in the verify_ledger CLAIM paraphrase + probe (§0.2 probe-illegal), and the fetched anchor names only 'debuff'; 'Flashbang' name != blind attestation (§0.4). Thermite Mine RR: §2 RR-branch shape-silent -> WITHHOLD token, support-lane note only. GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE = closest T4 to the scatter-cluster identity. CLOSE.
